notes: needs_ruling: the report opens «وجدت في بعض الكتب» (a found book with no author written); it is not settled whether محمد بن سنان is the book's source or a link after it
«[الْفُضَيْلِ]» in brackets is an editor's alternative spelling of المفضل, left out
«قال قال من قرأ» — the saying is relayed by المفضل, so he is the last link
